about: Labelled questions for the Joya planner eval (scripts/eval.mjs). Contexts: eval/contexts.json (AREA = a GENERAL context asked in the MANPOWER area, ACCOUNTING = the same in the accounting area; today 2026-10-21, location demo-tlv = demo Tel Aviv, demo-hfa = demo Haifa, order list 100, staffing plan 35 = week 2026-10-25..31). expect: calcs = names that must all be planned ('a|b' = either); params = per calc, values the params must have; range = from/to of the dated calcs; location = location ids the calcs must use; ops = 'none' | 'some' | list of partial ops that must each match one planned op; whatIf / draft = true when required (default: must be absent); maxCalcs = most calcs allowed. request = fields set on the context's request (e.g. scope, the picker choice). Values 'a|b' accept either.
